name: Hume AI
desc: Voice AI you direct emotionally, with voice cloning.
desc_zh: 能指定情绪说话、也能克隆人声的情感语音 AI。
solves: Synthesized speech reads like an announcement. Hume lets you direct the emotion it performs in, and clone a voice you own.
solves_zh: 合成语音念得像播报。Hume 让你指定它用什么情绪去演，也能克隆一段你拥有的声音。
best_for: Audio where the voice has to sound like it is feeling something, not reading.
best_for_zh: 做有声内容，需要声音听起来在表达而不是在念稿。
notes: The strongest differentiator in voice is now performance direction — what the tool is instructed to feel, not just naturalness. 来源：https://apps.apple.com/mo/app/hume-your-personal-ai/id6502917807
